# agency-healthcare

The **Healthcare** division of [The Agency](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents): 3 specialist subagents for Claude Code, copied unchanged from upstream.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add efycacement/claude-kit
/plugin install agency-healthcare@claude-kit
```

Restart the session afterwards. Plugin agents are namespaced: ask for an agent by name ("use the Clinical Evidence Agent agent to...") or pick it from `/agents`.

Without the plugin system, copy the files into your Claude Code config:

```bash
cp plugins/agency-healthcare/agents/*.md ~/.claude/agents/
```

## Agents

| Agent | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 🩺 Clinical Evidence Agent | Evidence standards and clinical credibility framework for AI agents |
| 🧭 Healthcare Innovation Strategist | Strategic narrative architect for healthcare founders operating at |
| 🌍 Sovereign Health Systems Agent | Government health mandate engagement framework for AI agents |
